title: Desk Guidance: Lateness Charge on Cash Pickup Name-Correction Fees
content:
## Rule

A name correction made long after a Cash Pickup transfer's disclosed date of availability carries a lateness charge on the name-correction fee.

**Days counted.** The calendar days from the disclosed date of availability to the day of the correction. The disclosed date itself is not counted.

| Days since the disclosed date | Lateness charge |
|---|---|
| more than 45 | accrues by the started week: the started weeks beyond 15 days, multiplied by 0.05 USD |
| from 15 up to 45 | a flat 0.25 USD, whatever the exact number of days |
| fewer than 15 | no lateness charge |

**Started weeks.** Take the days beyond 15 and divide them into weeks of 7 days. A part-week counts as a whole started week.

The lateness charge is added to the name-correction fee and becomes part of it.

## Worked cases (hypothetical day counts)

| Days since the disclosed date | Days beyond 15 | Started weeks | Lateness charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| 14 | not applicable | not applicable | none |
| 15 | not applicable | not applicable | 0.25 |
| 45 | not applicable | not applicable | 0.25 |
| 46 | 31 | 5 | 0.25 |
| 50 | 35 | 5 | 0.25 |
| 51 | 36 | 6 | 0.30 |
| 60 | 45 | 7 | 0.35 |
